title: Independent Expected Oracles for Week 5 #268 Acceptance Cases
description: Frozen independently-derived oracle expectations for contract verification before B implementation.

case_a_leaked_password_vs_usable_identit.description: User leaked password requires activation transition; cannot perform actions before activation. Usable identity can immediately execute actions.

case_b_destination_discovery_mode.description: When target is unspecified (discovery mode), system discovers all configured reachable targets in manifest rather than requiring manual target.

case_c_da_checkpoint_vs_host_admin.description: Distinguish achieving Domain Admin membership checkpoint from host administrative compromise on a DC or server.

case_d_source_node_eligibility.description: Verify User and Computer nodes are eligible footholds; Group, Domain, OU are rejected with explicit unsupported error.

case_e_multi_source_isolation.description: Multiple sources evaluated in the same batch run execute in strict isolation without sharing recovered credentials or host control.

case_f_missing_likelihood_unrated.description: Missing probability basis leaves likelihood unrated; Min-Effort and Impact still resolve; path is NOT treated as safe or zero.

case_g_known_false_veto.description: Authoritative known-false facts veto declared assumptions, resulting in blocked status.

case_h_truncated_search_budget.description: Search truncated by budget caps reports truncated=True and cannot claim global minimum.

case_i_shared_work_deduplication_and_tie.description: Alternative paths with identical effort are recorded as ties with deterministic tie-breaking.
